name: Nose + ear trimmer

lead: A nose and ear trimmer is a small rotary-blade tool that trims hair from the nostrils and ear openings. It is a low-cost way to remove visible hair.

Trimming is generally preferred to plucking. Nasal hair is thought to filter particles, and one study associated denser nasal hair with lower asthma rates in seasonal rhinitis, which has led to the suggestion of trimming short rather than removing all hair.

paras: A guarded rotating blade cuts hair near the opening while the guard keeps blades from touching the sensitive lining.

Plucking or waxing nasal hair may cause irritation or infection. Over-trimming reduces the filtering role, though the asthma association comes from one observational study and does not establish harm. Blades should be cleaned.
